verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs name official Sandbox SDKs as the recommended way to integrate. They give a programmatic interface to create sandboxes, run commands and manage files, with `@vercel/sandbox` for JavaScript/TypeScript and SDK methods such as `sandbox.extendTimeout()` and automatic snapshot-on-stop. A public OpenAPI spec also exists for generating other clients. Missing for 10: no explicitly named SDKs for languages beyond JS/TS (e.g., Python) despite the plural "SDKs", and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.
